cohort: All infant deaths reported by the municipality of Vitória de Santo Antão, Pernambuco, Brazil, to the Mortality Information System between 2011 and 2018.
finding: Cesarean birth, birth outside the municipality, brown and black race, prematurity, and a 5-minute Apgar score <7 were associated with neonatal mortality.
mod_finding: Cesarean birth was associated with lower neonatal mortality.
